addition: The [process dossier](../../dossiers/process.md) **extends** Account re-entry at register 3 by asking what an achieved form makes possible next. A changed qualitative whole, an occasion becoming available to another, a constitutive production network and a formal self-indication require distinct descriptions. The [process-science development](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** those distinctions through their selected carriers and wider scientific branches. Together they return a practical requirement to E4: identify the transformation, the condition it changes and the next operation that can receive that change. Exact technical consequences and phenomenal duration retain separate tests.
